data_fields.name: run_away_hp_percent
data_fields.donor_constant: 0, 25, 40, 60, 75, 100 by run-away mode (min_hp = max - max x v / 100)

data_fields.name: attacker_rating
data_fields.donor_constant: melee damage (or larger held weapon max damage) + armour class

data_fields.name: retaliation_switch_rule
data_fields.donor_constant: switch only if attacker rating strictly higher

best_idea: Keep attacking the unit that last hit you (or that you last attacked) while it lives, and fall back to the nearest seen, reachable enemy only when it is gone.
decision_why: The order (hold the last hitter, then the three who-is-fighting-me categories, then seen and reachable) is the one-engine many-on-one target rule Frankendom needs for MAX_ATTACKERS = 3; adapt because the donor's cap of 3 is its category count, its sort names disagree with its sort direction, and its ranges must become data.
acceptance: Server test: with hero A hitting an NPC, the NPC's target stays A on every tick while A is alive and in perception; after A dies it targets the nearest living unit on A's side (fixed seed, tick log asserted).
